title: Schema: headStageKey on Item and the listItemsByHeadStageAndUpdatedAt index
description: amplify/data/schema.ts and amplify/data/resource.ts: add headStageKey: a.string() to Item and ONE secondary index index("headStageKey").sortKeys(["updatedAt"]).queryField("listItemsByHeadStageAndUpdatedAt") (projection ALL; the index holds one row per lineage). Add headStageKey to TENANT_SCOPED_INDEX_FIELDS (src/papyrus_content/tenancy.py) so a tenant backend stores tenant#stage, and the itemsByHeadStage alias to INDEX_DEFINITIONS in graphql_authoring.py. This is the only GSI change in its deploy (one GSI per deploy per table). Ships in the same release as the dual-write task. Deploys: 1 backend deploy per site (7), each needs Ryan's approval; MoM first, then the other six in one batch. Acceptance: deploy succeeds on MoM; the new index exists and is empty; nothing else changes for readers.
